EGY.note: Only a Charter for Responsible AI and a governance dialogue; no rule with legal effect stated.
Microsoft is to advise agencies on use cases; no AI system tendered, piloted or in use is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology says the MoU supports implementation of Egypt's National AI Strategy 2025-2030, its second edition.

Under an MoU signed on 21 April 2025 the ministry and Microsoft Egypt plan to train about 100,000 trainees on AI, including employees of digital transformation units in ministries and government agencies.
Under an MoU signed on 21 April 2025 the ministry and Microsoft Egypt plan to train about 100,000 trainees on AI, including youth and IT professionals.
